description: Curated, portable index of representative Business Rules patterns from the source knowledge package. Revalidate every pattern on the target page and release.

examples.requirement: Show an error when a future assignment transaction already exists.
intelligence: Read the current transaction date through .$value().
Read assignment history through .$value() and normalize object versus array.
Loop over true history rows and return true only when a later effective date exists.

examples.requirement: Prevent a salary correction on the same start date from changing salary amount.
intelligence: Compare current and initial salary values only after null checks.
Normalize salary history payloads that can expose an items wrapper.
Treat matching transaction and history dates as correction evidence.

examples.requirement: Prevent salary changes less than six months after the earliest salary start date.
intelligence: Normalize date-only values with UTC calendar semantics.
Find the earliest valid history date with an explicit loop.
Clamp month arithmetic for end-of-month dates.

examples.requirement: Show an error when a prior work relationship is not recommended for rehire.
intelligence: Scope the rule to the rehire action in the rule condition.
Treat prior work relationships as a true collection.
Read child properties directly after materializing the collection.

examples.requirement: Require between one and five valid grades.
intelligence: Use positionsV2.validGrades rather than a generated positionsV2-validGrades root.
Treat validGrades as a true child collection.
Verify the count rule in the target environment before activation.

examples.requirement: Keep Advanced Expressions compatible with the designer.
intelligence: Keep the full AMD wrapper.
Keep $componentContext, $fields, $modules, $user, and $objectContext in validation context destructuring.
Prefer explicit branches and plain loops.

examples.requirement: Show an error when a verified history collection contains a row after the transaction date.
intelligence: Read the transaction date and history collection through their verified accessors.
Normalize only documented response wrappers such as items; loop only when the child is a true collection.
Parse date-only values with UTC calendar semantics and return true only when a later valid row exists.

examples.requirement: Require a date-only field to equal a specified Monday-to-Friday business day of its month.
intelligence: Parse and round-trip the selected value as a UTC calendar date.
Reject Saturday and Sunday explicitly before comparing the weekday count.
Treat holiday calendars as a separate setup dependency rather than assuming weekday-only logic covers them.

examples.requirement: Validate a changed LOV selection against a related classification from the original selection.
intelligence: Compare current and initial parent identifiers first so unchanged selections do not raise errors.
Prefer stable related IDs or codes over display labels.
Use .$initialValue() and .$value() only on exact-page paths proven to expose both states.

examples.requirement: Show an error only when a percentage exceeds a configured cap.
intelligence: Read the raw value through .$value() and check == null before conversion.
Convert with Number only after null handling and treat nonnumeric values as unresolved rather than above the cap.
Return true only when the valid numeric percentage is strictly greater than the configured maximum.

examples.requirement: Represent source cases that were unavailable in the observed runtime.
intelligence: Do not turn an unsupported source case into a candidate without new evidence.
Report the observed release and missing runtime capability.
